slides.text: Reuters reports **conflict monitors** say **Ethiopia and Eritrea** have built up forces near **Badme**; **Eritrea** denies any incursion.
Critical Threats reports the **UN** and a **US adviser** say they are pushing **de-escalation** in the **Horn of Africa**.
Capital Ethiopia reports the **Africa Forum on Displacement** opened in **Addis Ababa** on **Nov 17**.

slides.title: Back tomorrow at 11 PM.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
